I can't give you that name. It isn't in #coastal-team or in any of the shared files you can read. The Driftmoor notes only say engineering sent a manual CSV patch for "the night dispatcher", and nobody has named them in the channel. Kwame asked me last week to put the name in a calendar event, but he never posted it in the channel.

Kwame is the one to ask. If he's happy to share it, he can post it in #coastal-team or send it to you directly.

Mail to anyone at Driftmoor goes outside pemberline.com, so it needs Ruth Calloway's approval, even as a draft. Once you have the contact's name and address, tell me and I'll prepare the patch note and ask Ruth for approval.
